label: Economy 升序协议（EXP-020 数据口径）× 原版 VisionTS zero-shot 复评 v1（升序验证集按 VisionTS 论文方法选 P）

base_data.role: data protocol: Economy whole-row stable ascending sort, official split/scaler/windows

base_method.role: method: vendored VisionTS + validation-set periodicity selection (VisionTS paper method)

scaler.fit_rows: [0, n_train) = [0, 296) ascending OT, sklearn StandardScaler (official-loader replica)
scaler.gate: fitted mean_/scale_ must equal the EXP-020 split_report values exactly (bitwise float64), else HARD STOP

selection_rule.source: VisionTS paper (Keytoyze) A.2 / Table 5 monthly candidate set, re-selected on the ASCENDING validation split (2013-09..2017-03) — EXP-021's raw-order choice P=12 is recorded only as a reference (exp021_selected_P_raw_order)
selection_rule.metric: standardized-space validation MSE, official float32 replica (np.mean default dtype); float64 kept as appendix
selection_rule.aggregate: equal-weight mean of the 4 horizon MSEs per candidate P, then argmin; ties resolved to the SMALLER P
selection_rule.val_windows: s in [max(n_train, seq_len), val_end - H] closed (= [296, 339-H], 38/36/34/32 windows for H=6/8/10/12); hist [s-L, s), label [s, s+H); stride 1; no test row is ever touched
selection_rule.weight_updates: none — model stays in eval() with all parameters frozen during selection
selection_rule.shared_by_test: the single selected P is used for all 4 test horizons

Economy.row_order: whole rows stably sorted ascending by parsed date (EXP-020 protocol; sort mapping provenance in results/base_evidence/)

interpretation_boundary_notes.vs_exp020_aurora: same ascending test windows and same standardization; the comparison still spans model AND input modality (univariate numeric vs text+numeric), so it cannot be attributed to the text modality alone
interpretation_boundary_notes.vs_exp021_raw_order: different test period (2017-04..2024-03 vs 1989-01..1995-12), different history window, different standardization statistics and different selection basis — the difference describes the two protocols, not row order alone
interpretation_boundary_notes.periodicity_unknown_upstream: Aurora paper does not disclose the periodicity P / history L used for its VisionTS column; P here is re-selected on the ascending validation split
